description: A peer recorded Ed3 by CAS-1 stays Ed3 when a CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit arrives from it, and keeps getting EMPTY.
note: As drc-empty-to-ed3-peer (0.0.1.3 recorded Ed3 by its request at 2000), then at 2500, in the same burst, a WARNING D_PDU (type 15, received frame type 0, reason 0) from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 3, EOT 10, EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY with Ed4 set. A CAS-1 record always wins over a received CAPABILITY (C-1261), so 0.0.1.3 stays Ed3; the WARNING goes to the CAS, which is not calling 0.0.1.3 and ignores it (C-0589, B-0411). At 52000 the accept goes with EOW 0, EMPTY, and no PADDING even though the 48-byte block has room (C-0419, C-1154). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 48 bytes and 4800 ms a block; the type 8 D_PDU carrying a one-byte CAS-1 C_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) is 25 bytes, so the transmission is one block, 5550 ms, and every D_PDU in it starts in block 0: EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043), and the type 8 reception window 10 (C-0350). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 draws slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The link is made when the accept has been sent, at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400, C-1100), with the timers of cas-make-called-accept.
